title: Divaricate

inlines.v: DIVARICATE, verb intransitive [Latin , to straddle.] To open; to fork; to part into two branches. DIVARICATE, verb transitive to divide into two branches. DIVARICATE, adjective In botany, standing out wide. A divaricate branch forms an obtuse angle with the stem. It is applied also to panicles, peduncles and petioles.
